## Frequently Asked Questions – Ashcombe Bay T‑Shirt  

| # | Question | Answer |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | **What material is the Ashcombe Bay tee made from?** | 100 % premium combed, ring‑spun cotton. It’s breathable, soft‑to‑skin, and has a relaxed fit that’s great on a sunny day or a weekend in town. |
| 2 | **What sizes are available?** | S, M, L, XL, XXL. Please reference the sizing chart on the product page to find your best fit. |
| 3 | **Is the crest design printed or embroidered?** | The crest is a high‑resolution screen‑printed design, all‑over the shirt, to keep the vibrant seaside colors looking crisp wash after wash. |
| 4 | **Do I need to pre‑wash before wearing?** | No. The cotton blend is pre‑shrunk, so no adjustment is needed. If you want to keep the colors looking sharp, wash the shirt inside out in cold water. |
| 5 | **Can I send this in as a gift? What’s the wrapping option?** | Absolutely! For purchase you’ll see an option to gift‑wrap, or you can opt to include a handwritten card. Shipping is the same as standard orders. |
| 6 | **How do I care for the crest detail?** | Gentle cycle, avoid bleach or fabric softener, tumble dry low or line‑dry. Spot‑clean with a mild detergent if needed. |
| 7 | **What if the tee doesn’t fit? What’s the return policy?** | Returns are accepted within 30 days of receipt. The shirt must be unworn, in original tags and packaging. Return shipping is free for size‑exchange returns. |
| 8 | **Where does the Ashcombe Bay crest come from?** | It’s a stylized illustration of the historic crest of the fictional seaside town “Ashcombe Bay.” It’s a unique, limited‑edition design for genuine nautical‑folk pride. |
| 9 | **Can I request a custom color or size?** | Currently, the Ashcombe Bay tee is only offered in classic white and the standard sizes listed above. (Feel free to email us if you’d like a bulk order or special requests.) |
|10 | **Will this shirt be restocked?** | Once sold out, the Ashcombe Bay tee is a one‑time release. Keep an eye on our newsletter for future limited‑edition drops. |
